Specifically, Section 9.6.2 states that the appropriate, exclusive and convenient forum for any disputes arising out of this Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby shall be in any state or federal court in Houston or Dallas, Texas.","citations": [{"chunk_id": "C4", "quote": "Each Party agrees that the appropriate, exclusive and convenient forum for any disputes between any of the Parties arising out of this Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby shall be in any state or federal court in Houston or Dallas, Texas, and each of the Parties irrevocably submits to the jurisdiction of such courts solely in respect of any legal proceeding arising out of or related to this Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby."}]}
